# Razi's Experiments

> A personal playground for exploring UI interactions, shaders, and modern web development techniques built with Next.js, React Three Fiber, and Framer Motion.

This site is designed for rapid prototyping of web design and development ideas. Each experiment is isolated and self-contained.

## Site Structure

- [Homepage](https://raziexperiments.vercel.app/): Main dashboard listing all experiments
- [Experiments](https://raziexperiments.vercel.app/experiments/): Individual experiment pages with interactive demos

## Source Code

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/raztronaut/experiments-tool): The scaffolding tool used to create this experiments workspace

## Technologies Used

- Next.js 16 (App Router)
- React Three Fiber / Three.js for 3D graphics
- Framer Motion for animations
- Tailwind CSS & Shadcn UI for styling
